Shared parity corpus for the ExtendDB WebAssembly build.
An ORDERED sequence of cases run against ONE fresh engine. It is executed
two ways with IDENTICAL expectations:
* native — tests/parity.rs runs each case through
extenddb_wasm_adapter::Engine, i.e. real sqlx + C SQLite, the
fidelity ORACLE.
* wasm   — parity/run.mjs runs each case through the browser wasm module
(adapter -> engine -> the synchronous SQLite shim -> bundled
SQLite) under Node.
Both asserting the same values is what makes the port's fidelity checkable.
Each case:
name    human label.
op      the X-Amz-Target operation name.
body    request as a JSON object (stringified before submit).
rawBody optional: a verbatim request string submitted instead of body
(used to exercise the malformed-JSON error path).
error   null for success, else the expected DynamoDB error short-name
(the segment of __type after '#', then after '.').
checks  assertions on the parsed response. Each is one of
{path, equals}, {path, contains} (substring of a string member),
{path, present:true}, or {path, absent:true}. A JSON Pointer
addresses the member; N values are strings in the wire shape.
Results that DynamoDB does not order (Scan, BatchGetItem) are asserted only
on counts/membership, never on positional value; genuinely ordered results
(Query within a partition or index) are asserted positionally.

cases.name: CreateTable Products (single-key)
DescribeTable Products is ACTIVE immediately (in-memory control plane)
PutItem p1
GetItem p1 returns the stored item
Scan Products counts one item
Conditional UpdateItem accepts when the condition holds
Conditional UpdateItem rejects when the condition fails
GetItem p1 is unchanged after the refused update
DeleteItem p1
GetItem p1 after delete has no Item
GetItem on a missing table is ResourceNotFoundException
CreateTable Products again is ResourceInUseException
CreateTable Account
PutItem demo account with attribute_not_exists creates it once
PutItem demo account again is refused (create-once)
Checkout: conditional UpdateItem accepts within the cap
Checkout: conditional UpdateItem rejects over the cap
GetItem demo account is unchanged after the refused checkout
CreateTable Cart (composite key)
PutItem Cart line a1/p1
PutItem Cart line a1/p2
Query Cart partition a1 returns both lines in sort-key order
CreateTable Gsi (global secondary index)
PutItem Gsi a/g1
PutItem Gsi b/g1
Query the GSI returns both items sharing the index key
CreateTable Lsi (local secondary index)
PutItem Lsi a/z (lsiSk 5)
PutItem Lsi a/y (lsiSk 3)
Query the LSI returns the partition ordered by the index range key
CreateTable Str with a stream enabled
PutItem Str s1 (writes a stream record)
ListStreams names the table's stream
CreateTable Page
PutItem Page k0
PutItem Page k1
PutItem Page k2
Scan Page with Limit 1 returns one item and a paging cursor
TransactWriteItems writes two items atomically
TransactGetItems reads both items in request order
TransactWriteItems is cancelled when a condition fails
BatchWriteItem writes two items
BatchGetItem returns both items with nothing unprocessed
PutItem over the 400 KiB item-size limit is a ValidationException

cases.name: CreateTable VecT with a vector index succeeds
DescribeTable VecT reports the vector index
UpdateTable creating a vector index is refused by the WebAssembly build
PutItem VecT after the refusal (the instance still serves)
GetItem VecT after the refusal returns the item
UpdateTimeToLive enables TTL on Products
DescribeTimeToLive reports TTL enabled
PutItem with a past TTL timestamp
GetItem still returns the expired item (no background sweep removes it)
ListBackups returns an empty list with no cursor
DescribeContinuousBackups reports point-in-time recovery disabled
Enabling point-in-time recovery is unavailable
Disabling point-in-time recovery succeeds
ImportTable is disabled
ExportTableToPointInTime is disabled
CreateBackup is refused by the WebAssembly build
DescribeBackup is refused by the WebAssembly build
DeleteBackup is refused by the WebAssembly build
RestoreTableFromBackup is refused by the WebAssembly build
RestoreTableToPointInTime is refused by the WebAssembly build
ExecuteStatement is refused by the WebAssembly build

Deeply-nested PartiQL (2629 chars) is refused, not walked
